The '''Pypin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]] [[Sector/Legends|Sector]], which is in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. One of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the system was [[Pypin]].
